description: Each character sex's resource facts, which only the library loads (CjsCharacterLibraryManager.sexFacts): `root`, the paper doll content root every category path is relative to; `skeleton`, the master skeleton the character is skinned to; `defaultMorphs`, morph weights every character of the sex starts from, under any sculpt (the eye-missing morphs at these weights seat the eyeball against the lids, which the shipped idle poses leave proud of them; our setting: neither Carbon nor the client has default morph weights). Ours: the client's paper doll is Python. Edit freely: the engine reads this file as data.
